task.title: Administrator Guide: Configure a Security Policy

context.p: Security policies determine how SentinelGate evaluates requests before forwarding them to an AI provider.

step.cmd: Select Create policy or open an existing policy.

step.info: For this portfolio example, enable prompt-injection protection and sensitive-data detection.

step.cmd: Select the action for blocked requests.
step.info: A blocked request can return an error and create a security event.

result.p: The policy is saved and available for assignment to a gateway.

example.title: Example policy
example.p: Use metadata-only logging when request content must not be retained.
